## 要解决的问题 / Problem

<!-- 用户正在做什么？当前哪里受阻？ / What is the user trying to do, and where are they blocked? -->

## 建议方案 / Proposal

<!-- 描述最小可用版本，以及用户会看到的变化。 / Describe the smallest useful version and what the user would see. -->

## 示例场景 / Example scenario

<!-- 使用虚构或明确标注的假设场景，不包含个人信息。 / Use a fictional or clearly labeled hypothetical scenario without personal data. -->

## 验收标准 / Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 预期行为 / Expected behavior:
- [ ] 空态、失败或取消时的行为 / Empty, error, or cancellation behavior:
- [ ] 适用页面、设备或语言 / Relevant pages, devices, or languages:

## 考虑过的其它方案 / Other options considered

<!-- 你考虑过什么？为什么当前方案更适合这个任务？ / What else did you consider, and why does this proposal fit the task? -->

## 内容与数据确认 / Content and data check

- [ ] 该请求用于假设性推演、推想创作或产品功能。 / The request supports hypothetical simulation, speculative fiction, or product functionality.
- [ ] 不要求诽谤、骚扰、冒充真实个人、泄露隐私或违法指导。 / It does not request defamation, harassment, impersonation of real people, privacy leaks, or unlawful instructions.
- [ ] 不包含密钥、token、Authorization header、用户标识或个人数据。 / It contains no keys, tokens, Authorization headers, user identifiers, or personal data.
